Check the downloaded files against the release checksums

Source: R/download.R
fpc_verify.Rd

Compares the SHA-256 checksum of every file of the data folder that is listed in SHA256SUMS (download it with fpc_download("docs")). Needs the digest package.

Usage

fpc_verify(dir = NULL)

Arguments

dir

Data folder. Defaults to fpc_dir().

Value

A data frame with the file, whether it is present and whether its checksum matches.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fpc_download(c("docs", "fields", "composites"))
v <- fpc_verify()
v[v$present & !v$ok, ]   # files whose checksum does not match
} # }
